description: pixel art scene with one single character: a small mysterious figure in a dark navy hooded cloak, its face a glowing ice-blue light, glowing ice-blue hands, seen from the side facing right, standing at a small wooden jeweller's workbench and pressing a shining gem against a round grinding wheel on the bench, a gold ring and a few small coloured gems on the bench, a candle, dark stone workshop, the whole figure and the bench inside the frame

references.usage: the same small hooded figure: its dark navy cloak, its glowing ice-blue face and hands, its size in the frame, the dark stone backdrop and the pixel style; only the work and the place are new
